notes.title: Blade-Shift Rage is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Blade-Shift Rage is [b]OUT NOW![/b] 

Thank you so much to everyone that wishlisted it over the past few months, it's been great seeing people eager to player it and I really hope you enjoy playing it.

I'd love it if you left an honest steam review once you've played it, that would really help a lot.
